Unlock Conditions: Discover Acropolis of Atlantis; after that, enter/exit Temple of Poseidon.

How to activate: Use Crystal of Blessing and select this blessing.

Effect: For one hour, it becomes possible to transport a certain amount of trade goods through overland carriage routes (Paris-Calais, Great Plains-San Francisco) or through the Panama and Suez Canals. The amount is related to its current rank.

Rank 1 (0-19 Crystals used): Up to 1,000 trade goods
Rank 2 (20-39 Crystals used): Up to 2,000 trade goods
Rank 3 (40+ Crystals used): Up to 3,000 trade goods

Note that overland carriage routes charge an extra fee to transport Nanban trade goods; however, this charge does not apply to usage of the Panama or Suez Canals.
